ram.lore: A young ram from the Crossroads, proving that courage can begin with one small step.

basketball.lore: An enchanted basketball that escaped the academy court to chase a much bigger game.

book.lore: A forgotten spellbook that woke on a library shelf and decided to write its own adventures.

cat.lore: A streetwise cat who knows every roof, shortcut and secret supper in the Crossroads.

goalie.lore: A steadfast hockey guardian who treats every companion like a teammate worth defending.

baseball.lore: A wandering academy batter who trades stadium lights for the strange skies beyond town.

golfer.lore: A calm course scout who reads the curves of wild paths as carefully as the greens.

soccer.summary: Protect or sustain your team; playable solo.
soccer.lore: A lively enchanted football carrying the academy spirit into every unlikely team.

welder.lore: A forge worker who learned to mend town gates and burn away the darkness beyond them.

medic.summary: Protect or sustain your team; playable solo.
medic.lore: A masked field healer who goes where others retreat, carrying remedies for stranger dangers.

navigator.lore: A stargazer who follows wandering constellations to chart roads between broken worlds.
navigator.passive_brief: Seeking Orb sends two tracking shots.

ferryman.lore: An otter ferryman from Silverfall Reach, guiding lost travelers through the mist.
ferryman.passive_brief: Skipping Stones bounce to one extra foe.

dawnblade.lore: A wandering swordswoman who keeps the old orchard roads safe.
dawnblade.passive_brief: Sword Cut applies bleeding: 2 DPS for 4s.

stormscribe.lore: A wizard who reads the weather in the orchard clock towers.

vesper.lore: A bat courier who carries lost stars between broken observatories.

sunflower.lore: A sunlit garden guardian who followed a lost dawn to the Crossroads.

snowman.lore: A snow sculpture determined to see every season without losing his winter heart.

veyra.lore: An exile of Ebonwake who stole the Citadel’s forbidden ledger and learned to turn cruel magic against its masters.

drum.lore: A forgotten marching drum with a heartbeat loud enough to wake a realm.
drum.passive_brief: Nearby allies and you deal 8% more damage.

magnet.lore: A living horseshoe magnet drawn to the strange forces between realms.
magnet.passive_brief: Keep three anchors for Live Wire.

pippa.summary: Protect or sustain your team; playable solo.
pippa.lore: A red panda ribbon-weaver from Petalbrook Canopy.
pippa.passive_brief: Fern healing grants a brief 20% speed boost.

spindle.lore: A carved spinning top whose restless dance keeps forgotten winds alive.
spindle.passive_brief: Orbit Dance lasts one extra second.

patch.lore: A forgotten arcade controller awakened by Crossroads magic.
patch.passive_brief: Bit Buddies last two extra seconds.

bracken.lore: A fox sapper from Moonburrow Hollow, guarding the moonstone warrens from unstable mines and the restless Warren King.

elara.lore: A human prism mage who guards Moonveil’s mirrors from the jealous Marquis.

aurel.lore: A copper-scaled star dragon, small enough to fit through a town gate and old enough to remember when the sky was closer.

rune_duelist.lore: A human swordsman who stitches glowing runes into every step of a duel.

garrick.lore: A wandering male rune smith with a weathered beard and a hammer inscribed with three old promises: courage, swiftness and shelter.
garrick.passive_brief: Ward cleanses burn, bleed and poison.

nera.lore: A lantern courier from Brasslock Borough who unlocks impossible routes with enchanted keys and a ghostly last tram.
nera.passive_brief: Corkscrew Key pierces one extra foe.

teapot.lore: A runaway porcelain teapot whose mischievous woodland brew is delicious to friends and bitter to monsters.
teapot.passive_brief: Landing on poisoned foes restores health.

rook.lore: A travelling bridge keeper with a brass gauntlet and a salvaged chain.
rook.passive_brief: Grapnel hits empower the next Chain Sweep.

beaver.lore: An alder-bank beaver who builds bridges by daylight and fells corrupted timber by moonlight.
beaver.passive_brief: Stunning foes grants armour, up to 20%.

iris.lore: A travelling tutor who carries enchanted chalk and turns forgotten lessons into pathways of light.

robot.lore: Reclaimed from Neon Crucible, Bolt broke his factory oath to defend living towns.
robot.passive_brief: Three landed jabs add a volley missile.

cloudloom.summary: Protect or sustain your team; playable solo.
cloudloom.lore: A wandering weather-weaver who stitches stray clouds into rain and safe winds.
cloudloom.passive_brief: Wind lanes catch shots and return sparks.

cairnheart.lore: A badger stonecarver who carries the patient strength of the old hill roads.
cairnheart.passive_brief: Fault Steps hits grant up to 20% armour.

caelum.lore: A copper-cloaked mirror craftswoman with a braided mane and a polished hand mirror.
caelum.passive_brief: Prism Fold also slows foes for 2s.

dustdevil.lore: An enchanted brass vacuum from the town workshops.

velvetwing.lore: A silk-winged moth who weaves moonlit threads to keep lost travelers safe.
velvetwing.passive_brief: Tripline grants armour and poison reprisal.

wanderlight.lore: The antlered lantern guardian of Wayfarer Wilds, keeping a story for every trail.
wanderlight.passive_brief: Compass Turn grants a brief speed boost.

kage.lore: A masked night runner from the rooftops of Moonveil.

agent.lore: A quiet Crossroads operative whose red lenses find threats hiding between the worlds.
agent.passive_brief: Marked foes take stronger Ambush hits.

thistlebond.lore: A hedgehog envoy from the forest beyond town.
thistlebond.passive_brief: Two or more marked foes are poisoned.

chronicle.summary: Protect or sustain your team; playable solo.
chronicle.lore: A patient keeper of misplaced seconds, whose brass hourglass turns battlefield positions into promises.
chronicle.passive_brief: Second Needle marks last six seconds.

ripplejaw.lore: A stubborn river fish in a tideglass harness, determined to explore beyond the riverbank.

hearthwarden.lore: A mountain guardian carrying a traveling forge so no companion has to face the cold alone.
hearthwarden.passive_brief: Third hammer hit grants brief armour.

gopher.lore: A quarry gopher who knows the old mine tunnels better than the roads above them.

nullweaver.lore: A masked rift tailor who mends tears in reality with impossible needlework.
nullweaver.passive_brief: Rift seams briefly slow struck foes.

snail.lore: A volcanic snail carrying a living furnace, slowly seeking a place warm enough to call home.
snail.passive_brief: Nearby foes lose up to 40 armour points.

kite.lore: A sky smuggler riding a patched sail, collecting stories from places no road can reach.
kite.passive_brief: Completing a swing grants brief armour.

tidewright.lore: An otter sluice engineer from Confluence Foundry, keeping its waterways alive beside Spark Keeper.

cantor.lore: An otter conductor from Confluence Foundry, powering its copper halls beside Tide Keeper.
cantor.passive_brief: Lightning fields grant a speed boost.

shuttle.lore: An animated wooden weaving shuttle whose rose-coloured thread repairs forgotten roads.
shuttle.passive_brief: Finishing Seam Ride grants brief armour.

regent.lore: A masked keeper of discarded seconds, rescuing futures that almost never happened.

morrow.summary: Protect or sustain your team; playable solo.
morrow.lore: A gentle shepherd of forgotten spirits, lending the fallen one last chance to protect the living.
morrow.passive_brief: Raise a third ranged echo; echoes gain HP.

mantis.lore: A glimmering insect duelist who studies every opponent as patiently as a falling leaf.
mantis.passive_brief: A successful guard can restore 8 HP.

briar.summary: Juggle bouncing acorns, kick them into bigger blasts and vault along a delayed trail.
briar.lore: A woodland hare from Whispering Grove, collecting acorns that refuse to stay on the ground.

recess.summary: Sustain the team, cleanse harmful effects and create safe crossings. Works solo too.
recess.lore: An owl playground guardian from Firstbell Elementary, guiding small adventurers safely home.

votary.summary: Trade your health for offence, then recover some through precisely aimed returning blades.
votary.lore: A human oath-singer who carries an old promise written in crimson ink.

teacher.summary: Hybrid strikes, hold-and-release crowd control and magic-door positioning.
teacher.lore: A professional ram teacher of St.
teacher.passive_brief: Knowledge hits grant a brief ally ward.

lumen.summary: Aim darts to heal friends or hurt foes.
lumen.lore: A lantern-bearing courier delivering warmth and hope along the most dangerous roads.
lumen.passive_brief: Healing darts grant brief ally protection.

harbor.summary: Place safe crossings and projectile cover.
harbor.lore: A penguin harbour guide who lights safe crossings for anyone caught far from shore.
harbor.passive_brief: Harbor Note grants a brief 10% ally ward.

mosaic.summary: Grow separate tiles or combine them into a guardian.
mosaic.lore: An axolotl gardener who grows living mosaic tiles from fragments of forgotten gardens.
mosaic.passive_brief: Tiles move faster; capacity stays five.

apiary.summary: Deploy a hive and guide a ranged swarm.
apiary.lore: A human beekeeper-engineer who built a clockwork swarm to preserve the wild gardens.

bailiff.summary: Slow enemies and rearrange dangerous fights.
bailiff.lore: A patient tortoise with a cane, settling woodland disputes with gentle but unbending authority.

tempo.summary: Time your twelve-second stance cycle. Poison and shadow are special stances.
tempo.lore: A traveling martial artist whose twelve-second bell keeps body, breath and shadow in balance.

quill.summary: Bound into close combat, or equip mastery to command a quillpack.
quill.lore: A brave porcupine whose springing quills carry the wild woodland into every battle.
quill.passive_brief: Claws and lunges grant brief armour.

cindervane.summary: Practice close feather rhythm and aimed curling leaps.
cindervane.lore: A proud ember phoenix who carries a spark of dawn through even the darkest defeat.
cindervane.passive_brief: Revive at half HP; once every two minutes.

tova.summary: Keep allies together with stepping lights and a lantern refuge.
tova.lore: A lantern newt who guides lost travellers through Lanternmarsh. Her reed tongue and waylights keep nearby companions fighting together.
tova.passive_brief: Aura • nearby allies gain 2 HP on hit

merrymask.summary: Snap crossed puppet strings, call understudies and close the curtain.
merrymask.lore: A wooden theatre puppet who snaps crossed strings, calls understudies and closes the curtain on enemies.
merrymask.passive_brief: Scissors hits restore nearby puppet HP.

dunecook.summary: A living dessert chef: chop, simmer custard and serve a healing banquet.
dunecook.lore: A walking layer cake in a chef hat, bringing sweet comfort to hungry Crossroads adventurers.

dustmarshal.summary: Aim a pistol shot, hogtie enemies, then stampede or call deputies.
dustmarshal.lore: A bison frontier marshal keeping the roads safe with a steady aim and stubborn kindness.
dustmarshal.passive_brief: Shooting a tied foe restores 3 HP.

wick.summary: Frighten groups, scatter mixed treat patches and amplify allied critical bonuses.
wick.lore: A jack-o'-lantern from Lanternmarsh's autumn festival. Its brave little candle turns scary evenings into generous celebrations.
wick.passive_brief: Rotating candle aura: +50% critical bonus, +15% received healing.

cobbleclaw.summary: Catch shots in a stone shell, then scuttle through foes with a banked counterattack.
cobbleclaw.lore: A small masonry crab from Silverfall Reach, carrying a shell of polished river stones. It catches trouble in its claws and returns it with interest.
cobbleclaw.passive_brief: Each banked shot adds 3% damage reduction (max 12%).

twisterspell.summary: Grow and release weather funnels, connect lightning circuits and drop warned hail.
twisterspell.lore: A cheerful weather apprentice who collects river mist in her hat. She tends Crossroads’ new Mistglass Spire, turning unruly breezes into carefully bottled spells.
twisterspell.passive_brief: Lightning links at 3 funnels • full-charge zaps

hollow_rider.summary: Wind up a scythe, slam a spectral lantern and ride a ghostly horse.
hollow_rider.lore: An empty suit of armour carries a pumpkin lantern through Moonveil’s midnight roads. His spectral mare remembers every traveller he has guided home.
hollow_rider.passive_brief: Lantern Courage: hitting an enemy with Lantern Toll grants 12% damage reduction for 2 seconds.

hazel_hex.summary: Spin poison shots, bomb a broom route and brew a helpful cauldron.
hazel_hex.lore: Lantern Marsh’s kindly witch ties glowing embers to spinning spell-chains. Her broom delivers remedies—and a few surprises—to friends along the swamp roads.
hazel_hex.passive_brief: Ember Infusion: Broom Express bomb burns last one extra second.

echo_dancer.summary: Place delayed blade echoes, feint back and replay a three-step combo.
echo_dancer.lore: A travelling ribbon-swordsman from the Folded Coast who learned to dance between seconds. Every step leaves a memory; every memory can become another blade.
echo_dancer.passive_brief: Lingering Applause: afterimage damage increases from 50% to 65% of the direct primary hit.

little_menace.summary: Three fast punches, pocket-sized movement and a dangerous health trade.
little_menace.lore: This mouse brawler carries a pocketful of shrinking charms and an oversized sense of courage. Small does not mean safe: his boldest strike spends his own heartbeats.
little_menace.passive_brief: Small Courage: landing all three punches grants 10% damage reduction for 1.5s.

hearth_herald.summary: Enchant ally attacks with fire, share protective warmth and plant a healing banner.
hearth_herald.lore: An armadillo firekeeper from Ember Quarry carries the first coal of her village in a brass lantern. Her shell shelters travellers; her songs lend their weapons a little borrowed warmth.
